Welcome to Padel Share, the ultimate, game-changing application for paddle enthusiasts! We've designed Padel Share to meet all your needs related to American Paddle tournaments, delivering an intuitive, comprehensive, and enjoyable user experience.

Whether you relish the individual game or prefer the thrill of doubles, our platform can handle tournaments from 4 to 24 players. We've made it incredibly simple and accessible for you to configure every aspect of your tournament. With just a few clicks, you can personalize your tournament's name, set the meeting point, decide the number of courts and players, set the tournament date, and select the match type and scoring system. Prefer scoring by games won or matches won? Want to resolve ties by game difference or games won? With Padel Share, you're in control.

Once you've set up your tournament, Padel Share provides you with an organized and clear view of the event via a spreadsheet-like grid. This grid, divided by rounds, matches, and circuits, allows all participants to easily follow the action and progress of the tournament.

But Padel Share doesn't stop there. The tournament creator has the capability to update match results in real-time, providing instant access to information for all participants and followers of the tournament. With Padel Share, you'll never miss a beat of what's happening in your tournament.

Beyond organizing and tracking matches, Padel Share prides itself on its detailed ranking updated in real-time. With it, you can consult a broad range of statistics, from points and games won to matches tied and lost, and game difference. These metrics provide deep insight into each player's achievements and performances, elevating your tournament experience to an entirely new level.

We know that sharing the excitement and tension of a paddle tournament with others can amplify the fun, and that's precisely what Padel Share allows you to do. Our sharing feature gives you the ability to generate a unique code or QR code that you can share with whomever you wish. Moreover, we've included a QR code reader in the app to make accessing tournament information easy for all users.
